messages.subject: coord_flip() geom_hline mishap
parts:
Hi All,

I'm having a bit of a mishap with a function I am writing to plot summaries of one sample t-tests. I am creating horizontal box plots with red vertical lines to represent the null hypothesis. If I do vertical box plots everything is okay, but when I use coord_flip() to reverse the axes, the red lines get misplaced.

any thoughts?

as a side note, is there any way to get rid of the tick marks on the y axis, but not the x?

onesample.plot<-function(variables,data,test.value=0,scale=TRUE,type="hist"){
    n<-nrow(data)
    nl <- as.list(1L:ncol(data))
    names(nl) <- names(data)
    var.ind <- eval(substitute(variables), nl, parent.frame())
    dat<-data.frame(rep(NA,length(var.ind)*n),rep(NA,length(var.ind)*n))
    names(dat)<-c("Value","Variable")
    cnt<-1
    for(i in (1:length(var.ind))*n-(n)){
        dat[(1:n)+i,1]<-as.numeric(data[[var.ind[cnt]]])
        if(scale)
            dat[(1:n)+i,1]<-(dat[(1:n)+i,1]-test.value)/sd(dat[(1:n)+i,1],na.rm=TRUE)
        dat[(1:n)+i,2]<-names(data)[var.ind[cnt]]
        cnt<-cnt+1
    }
    max.diff<-max(test.value-min(dat$Value),max(dat$Value)-test.value)
    p<-ggplot(dat,aes(x=Value))

    hist<-geom_histogram(aes(x=Value,y=..density..))

    jit<-geom_jitter(aes(y=Value,x=0),alpha = .2, colour = "#326432", 
                    position = position_jitter(h = 0))
    box<-geom_boxplot(aes(y=Value,x=0),fill = NA, outlier.colour = "white",
                        outlier.size = 0, colour = "black", size = 0.75)
    o <- opts(axis.text.y = theme_blank(), axis.title.y = theme_blank())

    if(scale){
        p<-p+facet_grid(Variable~.)
        if(type=="hist")
            p<-p+ geom_vline(xintercept = 0,colour="red",size=1.5)+
                hist+xlim(-max.diff,max.diff)+o
        else if(type=="box")
            p<-p+ geom_hline(yintercept = 0,colour="red",size=1.5)+jit+box+
                ylim(-max.diff,max.diff)+coord_flip()+o       
        p<-p+ylab("Scaled Values")
    }else{
        p<-p+facet_wrap(~Variable,scales="free")
        if(type=="hist")
            p<-p+ geom_vline(xintercept = test.value,colour="red",size=1.5)+
                hist+o
        else if(type=="box")
            p<-p+ geom_hline(yintercept = test.value,colour="red",size=1.5)+jit+box#+
                #coord_flip()+o
    }
     p
}

##gives correct vertical boxplots
p<-onesample.plot(drat:mpg,mtcars,test.value=5,type="box",scale=F)
p

##box plots are okay, but vertical lines are misplaced.
 p+coord_flip()
